changelog:
- Initial release of the Interviewly API skill.
- Enables AI-powered mock interview workflows, including job description analysis, personalized question generation, real-time response feedback, and comprehensive interview reporting.
- Provides endpoints for health checks, session management, interview interaction, and PDF report download.
- Supports multiple pricing plans, from Free to Enterprise tiers.
- Suitable for job seekers, recruitment platforms, corporate training, and educational institutions.
summary: AI-powered voice mock interview platform that analyzes job descriptions and conducts adaptive interviews with real-time feedback.
